1) bulk_discount_percent incorrectly returns 5% for quantity 50.
2) parse_coupon rejects valid codes with whitespace or mixed case.
3) Cart.total calculates shipping based on wrong subtotal and misapplies bulk discount when a coupon is present, yielding incorrect totals (e.g., 120 widgets discounted gives 1836 instead of expected 2160).
4) Shipping fee logic in Cart.total may use original subtotal rather than post‑coupon amount.
